metadata.purpose: Select exactly the zero-based index, terminating as soon as it appears, or handle a missing index at source completion.

conditions: At most one next value, followed by completion on hit; normal empty source with default emits exactly one default.
Missing index without default errors with ArgumentOutOfRangeError, with no emitted value.
Cω counts next values; terminal notifications, resource release and cancellation are separate obligations.

scope.parameters: Nonnegative safe-integer index 2; explicit default is present. Negative/fractional indices excluded.
scope.callbacks: No user projection; skip indexed inputs by position without inspecting values.
scope.time: No timer. The selected item is forwarded at its source arrival; source completion decides only missing-index outcomes.
scope.reentrancy: Atomic non-reentrant source and callback outcome delivery; no observer/finalizer reentry inside the modeled reaction.
exclusions: Invalid, NaN, fractional and overflowing index values; construction-time negative-index error is not an execution transition.
The missing-error model uses a structurally named ArgumentOutOfRangeError; native RxJS error constructor is separately checked.
Observer reentry, throwing finalizers and callback-time cancellation.

initialization.sourceSubscription: One independently owned source connection is acquired at subscription, not construction.

ownership.sharing: None; independent operator state per subscription even if the upstream happens to be shared.
ownership.reset: Fresh subscription starts with new state; closed execution rejects all subsequent model inputs.

dispatch.actionSemantics: Index gate counts all source next events; when count equals requested index, output and complete then release upstream.
cancellationCheckpoints: Between source notifications or completed synchronous logical microsteps; silent release only.

inputs.description: begin a fresh execution, acquiring the source only now
